observed_claims: SSE Level-1 intraday snapshot historical data has a first issue date of 2 January 2014 and covers the frozen period.
The historical product manual defines snapshots at 3-second or 5-second intervals and states that when adjacent snapshots are identical only the first one is retained.
CIIS exposes official SSE Level-1 historical snapshot sample files.
The 2020 launch notice states that historical data is cleaned and published by SSE.
The STEP market-data specification has documented interface revisions during 2019 and 2020 and defines a real-time market-data session.
Network market-data gateways provide a retransmission service for missing supported data, but the specification states that snapshot market data is periodically published and cannot be retransmitted.
Snapshot messages contain OrigTime, which the specification defines as data generation time rather than an official dissemination timestamp.
SZSE/SSIC Level-1 is an officially distributed real-time market-data product.

SSE.decisive_reason: The official historical Level-1 snapshot product is a sampled and deduplicated historical representation, and the historical product is described as cleaned. Public evidence does not bind retained historical rows to the exact original real-time messages or a complete replacement/correction lineage.

SZSE.decisive_reason: The official protocol proves real-time publication and historical schema lineage, but snapshot OrigTime is generation time and snapshots are explicitly non-retransmittable. Bounded official evidence does not identify an official historical retention archive that binds exact retained snapshots to originally disseminated versions and correction/replacement completeness.

fixed_probe_matrix.reason: Product-level exact-version/dissemination evidence gate is not satisfied; downloading current historical values cannot repair it.

bounded_execution.targeted_gap_focus: SZSE snapshot time/retransmission semantics and SSE historical snapshot retention semantics
bounded_execution.early_stop_reason: Both products fail to prove the required exact historical version-to-dissemination binding at product level. Date-specific current values cannot close that evidence defect.

claim_ceiling: P032 establishes only that the two preregistered official Level-1 historical/realtime evidence chains did not prove exact historical message/snapshot version-to-dissemination binding under the frozen public evidence standard. It does not prove the original real-time feeds were incorrect or unavailable, does not prove no private licensed receipt archive exists, and does not establish any Stage10/11 point-in-time result. Four-party phase review closes the current Stage historical PIT source-evidence search and preserves P029 as retrospective development-shadow only.
